items.rationale: Covered under 2.3.3 overvoltage by lightning, within EUR 5,000 sub-limit; photo shows devices plugged into a plain power strip, which could trigger the 50% reduction, but this is uncertain. Case 9 put t below 336.
Delivery of replacement property is excluded under 7.1.8(b).
Installing or setting up replacement property is excluded under 7.1.8(c).
Covered surge damage within the sub-limit, no betterment allowed. Case 9 places t at about 517-616; a possible half reduction for no surge protector adds uncertainty.

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics
items.rationale: Bundled liability and service-arrangement charge without separate pricing, excluded under 3.1.4, 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
A charge for placing an order under a service arrangement is excluded under 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
Under 7.1.8(d) an attendance charge is not indemnifiable where no work on the same invoice is indemnifiable.
